name: queensway-aerial
js: (() => { const a = window.__CITY_APP; a.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [-7560,70,-1060], look: [-7670,0,-960], fov: 50 }); })()

name: queensway-person-start
js: (() => { const a = window.__CITY_APP; a.cameraSystem.cinema = null; a.selectMode('person'); a.selectCamera('chase', true); a.teleportTo(-7620.4, -993.9, -0.934); })()

name: queensway-person-end
js: (() => { const a = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY, e = a.controllerManager.getActiveEntity(), p = e.position; return { mode: a.controllerManager.activeMode, x: +p.x.toFixed(1), y: +p.y.toFixed(2), z: +p.z.toFixed(1), water: !!C.waterAt(p.x, p.z), roadBridge: !!(C.bridgeAt && C.bridgeAt(p.x, p.z)) }; })()
